_comment: icraft relocation (2026-05-30): Virtue's Prismatic Pond moved from overworld to Deep Aether (T4). Virtue is an angelic/holy boss (archangel_halo, angel_feather drops) -- a heavenly endgame dimension fits her theme AND matches her endgame summon gate (Unholy Lance = hellspec alloy + profanum), so no item rebalance is needed (per #54). Solid Deep Aether land biomes only (cloud excluded). CAVEATS: (1) prismatic_pond is a BURIED structure (step=underground, terrain_adaptation=bury); Deep Aether is floating-island terrain, so verify in-game that it buries cleanly rather than poking into the void -- fallback is a structure-level override to surface placement. (2) new-chunks-only.
